correctness.rationale: The normalization uses unit-length bins and cell-integral columns exactly. The two explicit indicator identities cover all columns via translations; for n>=3 four distinct target cells yield the two norms 2u(t+|2t-1|) and 2t(u+|2t-1|), while for n=2 modulo-two collisions cancel and yield the exceptional formula. Skew-adjoint kernel duality proves L-infinity equality. The cyclic Fourier cross-Gram (uI+tS) and standard two-projection angle blocks derive all Hilbert singular values, after which interpolation gives interior Lp continuity. Standalone independent-matrix rational tests passed 750 cases, including n=2 and t=1/2. Experiments do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: Shifted piecewise-constant conditional expectations are canonical in histogram discretization and alternating projection methods. The exact two-parameter operator-norm profile exhibits an extreme endpoint instability (limit 2 despite exact zero at alignment) that disappears in every strictly interior Lp norm, plus a mathematically forced exceptional two-bin cancellation. These are natural complete sharp invariants, not arbitrary numerical slices or a trivial special case of Hilbert principal angles. The first-order endpoint phenomenon is not obtainable by ordinary interpolation of Hilbert data.
